title: Agent Skills Engineering
summary: Build, route, secure, evaluate, package, and verify Agent Skills in real hosts.

prerequisites.title: Files, Python, and the command line
prerequisites.description: You can edit a text file, inspect a directory, and run a Python command. No agent framework experience is required.

prerequisites.title: Node.js, npx, and Python 3 for real labs
prerequisites.description: The install and bundled-script checkpoints require working node, npx, and python3 commands. The website and docs remain a conceptual fallback when these commands are unavailable.

prerequisites.title: One selected skill-capable host and install scope
prerequisites.description: Choose a supported agent host plus a writable project or user skill scope before installation. Record the exact host, scope, and installed path; do not infer discovery from installer success.

prerequisites.title: The Tool Interface
prerequisites.description: Skim this first if tool schemas and side-effect boundaries are new to you.

prerequisites.title: Tool Schema Design
prerequisites.description: Skim this first if you have not designed typed tool contracts.

prerequisites.title: Tool poisoning and untrusted instructions
prerequisites.description: Before Lesson 26, explain why skill and tool metadata is untrusted input. Lesson 15 is an optional refresher outside this five-lesson route when this preflight is not yet confirmed.

invocation.portableFallback: Use learn-agent-skills to start or resume the Agent Skills Engineering path.

conceptualFallback: Read the website or each lesson's docs/en.md manually. Mark real-host discovery, invocation, script, update, and uninstall evidence pending until Node.js, npx, Python 3, a compatible host, and a writable install scope are available.

quickStart.goal: Create a small skill, install the complete reviewer bundle into a real host, invoke it explicitly, verify its output, and remove it cleanly.
quickStart.workingDirectory: An empty learner workspace. Save its absolute path as TARGET_ROOT before installation.
expectedEvidence: The installer reports the selected host and destination.
The host discovers skill-contract-reviewer after a rescan or new session.
An explicit invocation returns a validation report and primitive choice, plus the resolved script path, target path, cwd, argv, and exit code.
The uninstall command removes only skill-contract-reviewer from the selected host.

lessons.title: Agent Skills: Portable Contract and Runtime Boundary
lessons.checkpoint: Create, install, invoke, verify, and remove one complete skill bundle in a real host.

lessons.title: Skill Discovery and Progressive Disclosure
lessons.checkpoint: Trace discovery, catalog publication, activation, and branch-specific resource loading separately.

lessons.title: Skill Invocation and Routing
lessons.checkpoint: Exercise explicit invocation, implicit selection, abstention, and a near-miss request.

lessons.title: Skill Permissions, Sandboxes, and Trust
lessons.checkpoint: Distinguish instructions, permission prompts, sandbox containment, and independent verification with observed evidence.

lessons.title: Skill Evals, Packaging, and Portability
lessons.checkpoint: Run the release gate in a real host, record routing and authority evidence, and verify upgrade and uninstall behavior.

optionalLessons.title: Capstone: Stateless Tool Ecosystem
optionalLessons.entryRule: Complete the Agent Skills route and Phase 13 lessons 06 through 20 before starting this systems integration capstone.
